brief:
Khalil al-Hayya, head of Hamas's political bureau, extended condolences to the Abu Hanouf family following the death of Hajja Fatima Fawzi al-Shuli, the mother of slain fighter Mahmoud Abu Hanouf, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Hayya conveyed his sympathies directly to the bereaved family.

The statement marked a formal expression of solidarity from the resistance movement's senior leadership with a family that lost a combatant in the ongoing conflict.

title: Hamas leader Hayya condoles family of slain fighter Abu Hanouf
